scenario_name: FNSKU Label on Bottom Seam — Apparel in Polybag
note: This is a second image submitted under scenario 4. It closely matches scenario 5 (FNSKU on seam) and has been annotated accordingly. The FNSKU label is placed at the bottom fold/seam region of the polybag, which is a compliance violation.

vlm_evidence.warning_text_ocr: WARNING: TO AVOID DANGER OF SUFFOCATION, KEEP THIS PLASTIC BAG AWAY FROM BABIES AND CHILDREN. DO NOT USE THIS BAG IN CRIBS, BEDS, CARRIAGES OR PLAY PENS. THIS BAG IS NOT A TOY.

polybag_present.reason: Transparent polybag clearly present enclosing the apparel item.

polybag_sealed.reason: Bottom of bag shows a visible heat-seal seam. Bag is closed and secure.

fnsku_placement.reason: CRITICAL: FNSKU label X0042E7KX5 is placed directly at the bottom fold/seam of the polybag. The label bridges across the seam edge, causing it to wrinkle. Placement on a seam is a violation — barcode may not scan cleanly.

fnsku_surface.reason: Surface classification: seam. FNSKU label is not placed on a flat, smooth polybag surface.

suffocation_warning.reason: Full, extended suffocation warning is printed in large, bold text at the top of the polybag. Fully compliant.

suffocation_legibility.reason: Text is high contrast, sharp, no wrinkles or obstructions. Also includes extended text about cribs, beds, carriages — exceeds minimum requirement.

manufacturer_barcode.reason: No original UPC/EAN barcode visible. Item is opaque black fabric — no through-the-bag barcode exposure detected.

annotations.label: ✅ Suffocation Warning — PASS
annotations.note: Full extended warning: 'WARNING: TO AVOID DANGER OF SUFFOCATION... THIS BAG IS NOT A TOY.' — fully legible, bold, high contrast

annotations.label: Recycling Symbol (PE-LD 04) + Made in China

annotations.label: ⚠ FNSKU on SEAM — FAIL
annotations.note: Label X0042E7KX5 is placed at/across the bottom fold seam of the polybag. surface_classification: seam. Barcode scannability risk.

quality_flags.notes: Close-up front/bottom view. Excellent training image for seam detection — the bottom fold of the polybag and the label bridging it are clearly visible. Warning text at top is pristine and provides a strong positive OCR training sample.

prd_rules_triggered: PRD §5.1 — FNSKU label must be applied to a flat, smooth surface. Placement across a seam, fold, or curved edge is prohibited.
training_notes.vrd_model_learning_value: VERY HIGH — This image is a perfect counterexample to scenario 1. It has an excellent warning (PASS) but fails on seam placement. The model must learn to evaluate each check independently — a good warning does NOT compensate for bad FNSKU placement.
training_notes.dataset_contrast_pair: scenario_01 (all PASS) vs scenario_04b (warning PASS but FNSKU seam FAIL)
